description:
[Deterministic Italian labour agreement audit. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits proposed salary against official statutory minimum wage tables (paga base, contingenza, terzo elemento, EDR) for national collective bargaining agreements (CCNL Commercio & Terziario Confcommercio, CCNL Metalmeccanica Industria Federmeccanica, CCNL Studi Professionali Confprofessioni). Evaluates job classification level and statutory biennial seniority increments (scatti di anzianità).
Usage: Use this tool to audit whether an employment contract complies with mandatory minimum wage levels under Italian law. Do NOT use for IRPEF tax deductions (use 'lordo_netto_irpef_simulator').
Returns: JSON object with { ccnlCode: string, jobLevel: string, statutoryMinimumMonthlyEur: number, offeredMonthlyEur: number, isCompliant: boolean, gapMonthlyEur: number, accruedSeniorityEur: number, legalBasis: string }.

monthsCount.description: Number of annual salary installments (13 or 14)

offeredMonthlySalaryEur.description: Offered monthly base salary in EUR excluding bonuses

seniorityIncrementsCount.description: Accrued biennial seniority increments count (scatti di anzianita)

name: ccnl_inquadramento_audit
title: CCNL Minimum Wage & Inquadramento Auditor
